body: Justin Herbert remains rostered with the Los Angeles Chargers as of late October 2026, though multiple reports indicate active trade speculation involving the Minnesota Vikings, Cleveland Browns, and other teams. While the Chargers have publicly shut down talks with the Vikings, other outlets suggest potential blockbuster deals or capital-heavy moves are being considered by various franchises.

findings.evidence_quote: Los Angeles Chargers Shut Down Justin Herbert Trade Talk With Minnesota Vikings
Browns Linked To Blockbuster Justin Herbert Trade With Chargers
